meta.name: ship
meta.description: Open a PR and merge it in one step — combines `bin/pr.sh` create with `bin/wait-for-pr-checks.sh` polling and `gh pr merge`. Default mode enables GitHub's native auto-merge so the terminal returns immediately; `--client-side` polls in the foreground and merges when CI goes green. TRIGGER when the user says "ship this PR", "ship it", "open and merge", "PR and merge", "create PR and auto-merge it", "wait for CI then merge", "block until merged", "/nyann:ship". Do NOT trigger on "open a PR" alone (no merge intent) — that's the `pr` skill. Do NOT trigger on "merge this existing PR #N" — ship is PR-creation + merge, not standalone merge of an already-open PR. Do NOT trigger on "release X.Y.Z" — that's the `release` skill, which tags a merged commit rather than creating one.
